{{Ooumb
| bg = #c5fcdc
| image = [[File:UnderConstruction.png|50px]]
| message = '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was the '''[[Wookieepedia:Improvement drive|improvement drive]]''' project for the weeks of: <br>

See how it improved: [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title={{{4}}}&diff={{{5}}}] [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title={{{4}}}&diff={{{6}}}] [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title={{{4}}}&diff={{{7}}}] &ndash; [[Wookieepedia:Improvement drive/History|Other improvement drives]]
}}<noinclude>

==Usage==

For articles that were improvement drive projects twice. Type <nowiki>{{IDformer2}}</nowiki> at the top of the article in question's talk page and fill in the following:

{{{1}}}: The first week it was the ID article; for example "13 November, [[2005]]".

{{{2}}}: The second week it was the ID article; for example "4 June, [[2006]]".

{{{3}}}: The second week it was the ID article; for example "10 November, 2006".

{{{4}}}: The article's title, with underscores; for example "C-3PO". Note that you must type "4=(title)".

{{{5}}}: The code following "&diff=" in the first "see how it improved URL; for example "129203&oldid=122158". Note that you must type "5=(code)".

{{{6}}}: The code following "&diff=" in the second "see how it improved URL; for example "511486&oldid=493879". Note that you must type "6=(code)".

{{{7}}}: The code following "&diff=" in the second "see how it improved URL; for example "7=915002&oldid=899172". Note that you must type "7=(code)".

Therefore, if put on [[Talk:C-3PO]], '''<nowiki>{{IDformer3|13 November, [[2005]]|4 June, [[2006]]|10 November, 2006|4=C-3PO|5=129203&oldid=122158|6=511486&oldid=493879|7=915002&oldid=899172}}</nowiki>''' produces:

{{Ooumb
| bg = #c5fcdc
| image = [[File:UnderConstruction.png|50px]]
| message = '''C-3PO''' was the '''[[Wookieepedia:Improvement drive|improvement drive]]''' project for the weeks of: <br>
*13 November, [[2005]]
*4 June, [[2006]]
*10 November, 2006
See how it improved: [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title=C-3PO&diff=129203&oldid=122158] [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title=C-3PO&diff=511486&oldid=493879] [https://starwars.fandom.com/index.php?title=C-3PO&diff=915002&oldid=899172] &ndash; [[Wookieepedia:Improvement drive/History|Other improvement drives]]
}}
